briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent capabilities amid regulatory scrutiny

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models while compute constraints and safety gaps widen. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with 4x agentic throughput; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 undercuts pricing by 60%. Meta and xAI accelerate open-weight releases.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New EU AI Act enforcement triggers audits; prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units shipped; Google and Microsoft announce 50GW data center expansions; TSMC secures $28B AI chip order backlog.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems reach autonomous goal modification before 2028 safety standards are enforced?
